tools.name: http-failure-classifier
tools.description: HTTP failures arrive as mixed status codes, timeouts, TLS errors, and HTML error pages, so agents cannot decide retry, backoff, or stop from one consistent class. $0.002 per call, USDC via x402 or MPP. Classifies a response snapshot, or one public GET with no credentials, into a retry class with a s

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "http-failure-classifier" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
